import base64, struct
for b in ['S1RFU1QAAAADAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAwAAAAJ4MAAAAAQHAAAAAAAAAngxAAAAAQEAAAACeDIAAAABAA==','S1RFU1QAAAADAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAwAAAAJ4MgAAAAEBAAAAAngxAAAAAQEAAAACeDAAAAAEBwAAAA==']:
  d = base64.b64decode(b)
  o = 5+4
  argc = struct.unpack_from('>I', d, o)[0]; o += 4
  print('argc', argc)
  for i in range(argc):
    pass
  o += 8
  cnt = struct.unpack_from('>I', d, o)[0]; o+=4
  print('objects', cnt)
  for i in range(cnt):
    nl = struct.unpack_from('>I', d, o)[0]; o += 4
    name = d[o:o+nl]; o += nl
    dl = struct.unpack_from('>I', d, o)[0]; o += 4
    data = d[o:o+dl]; o += dl
    print(' ', name, data.hex())
  print('  trailing', len(d)-o)
